hooks.command:
file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))")
[[ "$file" == *.py ]] || exit 0
uv run ruff format --config=.ruff.toml "$file"
uv run ruff check --fix --config=.ruff.toml "$file"
uv run ty check
uv run bandit -c .bandit.yml "$file"

file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))")
[[ "$file" == *.toml ]] || exit 0
python3 -c "import tomllib; tomllib.load(open('$file','rb'))"
[[ "$file" == *pyproject.toml ]] && uv lock || true

file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))")
[[ "$file" == *.yaml || "$file" == *.yml ]] || exit 0
python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('$file'))"

file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))")
[[ "$file" == *docker-compose.yml ]] || exit 0
docker compose config > /dev/null
